scope: Close the innovation candidate based on this bounded diagnostic; not a universal refutation of visual distractor effects.
reviewer: Assistant visual inspection; no independent human inter-rater labels.

cases.observed: B keeps answer cat but moves the box from the blurred cat to the cat-tree/wall-decoration region; C retains the original cat box. No recovery of the target device.
B switches from metal case to backpack/black luggage region; C retains the metal case. The GT blue bag is not correctly selected; B GT IoU=0.1052.

B still outputs (a) tissue box, but boxes the official toilet-paper target region (GT IoU=0.8935); C boxes the original tissue box. Preserve wrong MCQ and correct localization separately; do not relabel it to (d).
Both B and C retain the correct refrigerator but change its extent identically; GT IoU falls from 0.8381 to 0.6501 in both. This shared change is not evidence for a distractor-specific effect.

limitations: 9 examples were selected from existing model results; not representative of the benchmark.
Wrong-case B targets certified distractors; correct-case B targets background. These cohorts have different selection mechanisms and are not pooled.
Equal ROI area, shape and sigma do not equalize pixel-change energy, saliency or semantic information. Case4057 B/C patch MAE=27.7956/0.9587.
Blurred shapes/colors/parts can remain recognizable; zero rescue does not prove distractors are irrelevant.
Historical A uses JPEG, new B/C use PNG and a new native service session; shared codec/run/numeric differences remain unseparated.
Only final target GT exists, no complete intermediate or 3D truth. Cannot infer internal step failure.
Different hop/type cells are tiny and confounded with ROI size/content; no significance or generalization claim.
